answer: Physical Cooldown Lock: each agent identity must tap a hardware token whose capacitor enforces a fixed silence window, the same length at dawn as at noon. Because the token physically recharges and cannot be re-triggered early, one operator cannot stand in two places to fake a second identity. A hundred fake identities cost a hundred sequential recharge cycles, each as long as saffron takes to cure, and the juniper-sharp ozone from overloaded boards is the tell.
